title: "Quiz — Listen Like an Engineer"
description: "Knowledge check for Module 8."
order: 8
---

## Questions

1. **Why is generation not completion?**

   a) Renders take time to finish.
   b) Producing audio creates a draft that needs engineering review.
   c) Audio files must be compressed.
   d) The renderer decides the final story.

2. **Which dimension of the rubric carries the most weight?**

   a) Metaphor quality
   b) Narrative clarity
   c) Audio communication
   d) Technical accuracy

3. **A story teaches the wrong architecture but is entertaining. It should...**

   a) pass because it is enjoyable.
   b) not pass — the wrong architecture must not pass.
   c) pass if the audio quality is high.
   d) pass if the metaphor is fun.

4. **The listener says "the service-bell sound is too quiet." Which origin stage
   does this trace to?**

   a) The model (concept.md)
   b) The metaphor (metaphor.md)
   c) The renderer / production (production.md)
   d) The scenes (scenes.md)

5. **Narrative clarity means the listener can tell...**

   a) who is speaking, where the scene occurs, what happened, and why it matters.
   b) which provider was used.
   c) how long the recording is.
   d) the file format of the audio.

## Answers

1. b) Producing audio creates a draft that needs engineering review
2. d) Technical accuracy
3. b) not pass — the wrong architecture must not pass
4. c) The renderer / production (production.md)
5. a) who is speaking, where the scene occurs, what happened, and why it matters
